Defs.Name: The Marked Men
Defs.Description: A RimWorld mod adding a new faction of infected humans with enhanced AI behavior, vehicle combat capabilities, and unique medical conditions.
Defs.Author: The Pennes
Defs.Description: This mod adds a new infected faction with unique AI behavior, medical conditions, and combat capabilities. It introduces the 'Marked Men' as a distinct faction with their own vehicles, weapons, and AI behaviors.
